name: Phoenix Rebirth #88 — Thor & Loki, Storm and Trickster Eternal
description: One strikes with thunder. The other moves through cunning. Thor stands as the defender of order, force, and protection, while Loki embodies disruption, intelligence, ambiguity, and the dangerous necessity of change. In Norse myth, their tension shapes destiny itself. Neither fully destroys the other because each defines the world the other moves within. In their Phoenix reincarnation, storm and trickery become a single eternal current — power sharpened by chaos, chaos bounded by strength. They rise not as peace, but as the perpetual friction from which myth is born.
